svg.metadata: {"id": "s019", "name": "武术馆", "cat": "体育", "tags": ["体育", "武术", "传统文化", "健身"], "desc": "中式武术馆：红柱、斗拱横梁与“武”字匾额、方格花窗，红色比赛地毯，兵器架（刀枪剑棍）、大鼓、木人桩与红灯笼。", "stand": {"ground_y": 900, "x": [560, 1360]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "wall", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "windows", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "beam", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "pillars", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.25, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "floor", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "weapon_rack", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.4, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "drum", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.55, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "wooden_dummy", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.7, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "lanterns", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.85, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "lantern_glow", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "plants", "enter": "grow", "delay": 1.05, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}], "palette": {"wall1": "#FBEBD3", "wall2": "#F2D8B4", "pillar": "#C8392F", "pillar2": "#A82E26", "beam": "#8B5A3C", "beam2": "#6E452D", "gold": "#E8B84A", "gold2": "#C8962E", "lattice": "#8B5A3C", "paper": "#FFF6E4", "floor1": "#C99364", "floor2": "#B07B4F", "carpet": "#D9534F", "carpet2": "#C5443F", "cline": "#FFFFFF", "rack": "#7A4B2E", "blade": "#E3E8EE", "tassel": "#E8473B", "staff": "#C99A5C", "drum": "#C8392F", "drumtop": "#F2DEC0", "nail": "#E8B84A", "lantern": "#E8473B", "lantern2": "#FFB347", "dummy": "#9C6A43", "plaque": "#3D2A20", "ink": "#E8B84A", "leaf": "#5F9E6E", "leaf2": "#8CC08E", "pot": "#E9DCC6"}}
